QuestInfo.name: Glorious Worker
QuestInfo.0: #b#p9250125##k wants to reward you for your assistance in building the Time Machine.
QuestInfo.1: #b#p9250125##k says you'll get a reward if you help for one week!\r\nHmmm, what could the reward be?

0.0: Thanks for your help in creating the Time Machine. It'll still take a while before it's complete, though.
0.1: You probably got Doctor Bing's Honor Badge for your work today. Help for a week, and I'll give you another reward.

yes.0: Collect 7 Doctor Bing's Honor Badges to prove you've helped out for a full week. Just saunter on over and let me know when you've got all seven.

1.0: Here's the OS4 Shuttle you used while building the Time Machine. The attack function has been removed for safety reasons...
1.1: And there's not much fuel left in it. But take it. You can use it for a while, since we don't need it at the moment.

yes.0: I need to work on my research, so take care of yourself!
